annotations.title: What happened from question to verified fix?

description: The brand's loop, oldest first: each buyer question tracked, gap found, content draft created, fix published to the brand's site, fix shipped, change seen on the brand's own pages, and fix checked after it ships: a first check on day 28, re-checks on days 45, 60 and 75 and a final check on day 90 (whether it is still live and how citations, mentions and AI-referral traffic moved, each with its sample size; a horizon appears only once it has been measured). The first page also lists before_window: each question's newest draft, publish and shipped fix from before since, its current state. At most 90 days per call (the last N days is since = today minus N-1, today counted); page with next_cursor.

brand_id.description: Brand id from list_brands. May be omitted when the workspace tracks a single brand.

cursor.description: next_cursor from the previous call, to continue.

since.description: Window start: RFC 3339 timestamp or YYYY-MM-DD. Default 90 days before until.

stages.description: Optional: only these stages. Default every stage.

until.description: Window end: RFC 3339 timestamp or YYYY-MM-DD (that whole day). Default now. At most 90 days after since.
